name: Golden Days Lodges
tagline: Five lodges. One warm Zambian welcome.
rates_note: Rates are taken from the lodge's current website and may change. Please confirm when you enquire.

branches.name: Woodlands Main
branches.address: Plot No. 12238, Off Mosi O Tunya Road, Woodlands Ext, Lusaka
branches.tagline: Our main lodge in the heart of Woodlands, Lusaka.
branches.blurb: The original Golden Days. Comfortable, self-contained rooms from standard doubles to an executive suite, with breakfast included and a restaurant and conferencing facilities on site.

branches.name: Buluwe
branches.tagline: Quiet, comfortable rooms on Buluwe Road.
branches.blurb: A calm Woodlands address with straightforward, good-value rooms, ideal for business trips and longer stays.

branches.name: Makeni (Bonaventure)
branches.blurb: Our southern Lusaka lodge, with double and double deluxe rooms and the same Golden Days welcome.

branches.name: Livingstone
branches.address: 3S Chisamba Way, 2nd road behind the Museum, Livingstone
branches.tagline: Your base for Victoria Falls and the Zambezi.
branches.blurb: Stay in Livingstone, the adventure capital of Zambia, with rooms from standard to executive and self-catering apartments for longer stays.
rooms: Kitchenette with stove, fridge and microwave, living room, a double deluxe room, bath and shower.

branches.name: Senanga
branches.tagline: A welcome stop on the banks of the Zambezi.
branches.blurb: Affordable, comfortable rooms in the Boma area of Senanga, in Zambia's Western Province.
